svg.title: Achievements — 17 of 24 tiers earned
svg.desc: Scribe: tier 2 of 3 (559 commits this season); Questbreaker: tier 2 of 3 (132 prs merged, all time); Unbroken: tier 2 of 3 (21 days longest streak); Devoted: tier 2 of 3 (150 days active this season); Architect: tier 2 of 3 (59 repos founded); Wanderer: tier 2 of 3 (15 realms contributed to); Seeker: tier 2 of 3 (49 issues opened this season); Veteran: tier 3 of 3 (5 years on GitHub)
